The '''apartment''' of [[Republic Army]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ava Jaxo]] was on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] located in the [[Coruscant Heights Apartments]] area of the [[Black Sun territory]]. From here Sergeant Jaxo spied on the activities of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]].
